props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag-handle pill at the top of the sheet.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Paints a static ring matching `color`, ignoring focus state.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render — flat array, grouped (array of arrays), or string/number primitives.

props.name: labelKey
props.description: When `items` are objects, which field to use as the label.

props.name: name
props.description: Form submission name. Forwarded to the core `SelectRoot`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder rendered when no value is selected. Also used as the sheet title.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Presentation mode — kept for API parity with `VyPopover` /
`VyDropdownMenu`. Currently only `'sheet'` is wired (native picker UX
for touch). An `'anchor'` (tablet popper) variant is tracked separately
and falls back to `'sheet'` when requested today.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Iconify name rendered next to the selected item. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.check`.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the picker sheet slides and drags from.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Snap fractions forwarded to `SheetRoot`. Default `[0.5]` matches a
native picker — half-screen, scrollable list below the placeholder title.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the trailing side of the trigger. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.chevronDown`.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: When `items` are objects, which field to use as the value.

slots.name: leading
slots.type: { modelValue?: string | undefined; open: boolean; iconColor: string; }
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the trigger's resolved theme color.

slots.name: trailing
slots.type: { modelValue?: string | undefined; open: boolean; iconColor: string; }
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the trigger's resolved theme color.
